title: EachNdjsonRecord
description: One line of `rwv each --json -j N` output (`N > 1`): a flat outcome object carrying its own `$schema`, printed as that repo finishes.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock run time. Absent when the command did not run.

exit_code.description: The command's exit code. Absent when it did not run, could not be started, or was ended by a signal.

signal.description: The signal that ended the command (Unix only).

stderr.description: The command's standard error, decoded lossily as UTF-8. Holds the reason when the command could not be started.

stdout.description: The command's standard output, decoded lossily as UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The command exited non-zero, was ended by a signal, or could not be started.
`--timeout` elapsed and the command's process tree was killed.
Never started: `--fail-fast` or an interrupt stopped new repos first.
The repo's checkout is absent from disk; `rwv fetch` restores it.
